name: tag
title: Tag
summary: A small label attached to something: a category, an environment, a file.
description: A small bordered label attached to something: a category, an environment, an attachment. The squarer, bordered label of tables and fields (a category, an attachment, a value in a tags input) in neutral, accent or one of the eight tag hues, with an optional remove button. One line, never wraps or shrinks. Sizes md (24px) and sm (22px); rounded by default, pill in a pill-shaped host.

anatomy.description: 6px dot in the tag's hue; aria-hidden. Only when dot is set.
A glyph before the label (12px, 11px at sm) in the tag's colour, aria-hidden; takes the dot's place (an attachment's file glyph).
Text of the tag; truncates at the end when the tag has less room than its text, and then carries its full text as a title.

The real Button (ghost, xs, square), marked data-tag="remove", with an x icon and an aria-label; its shape follows the tag's (round on a pill, rounded on a rounded tag). The tag grows to 26px to hold it (the button is 20px at sm, and the tag stays 22px). Under a coarse pointer its hit area reaches 36px (a transparent ::after); the tag does not grow. With removeTooltip it sits inside the real Tooltip.

tone.description: neutral (ink-3), accent and the eight tag hues (from --fndn-tag-*). The fill is 14% of the hue on the surface, the 1px border 30%, the text the hue mixed with ink; dark: a richer fill (26%), border (34%) and lighter text.

variant.description: tint: the box takes the hue (fill 14%, border 30%, text mixed with ink). outline (Linear's labels): a neutral box (no fill, the strong hairline, ink-2 text) with the hue only in its dot, which shows without `dot` (an icon still takes its place): for many labels of many hues in a row, an issue's labels, a filter.

shape.description: Radius only: rounded is radius.control (radius.chip at sm); pill for a tag in a pill-shaped host (a prompt-bar attachment).

dot.description: Render the leading dot part in the tag's hue. Always shown in the outline variant.

removable.description: Render the remove button at the end.

removeLabel.description: aria-label of the remove button, e.g. "Remove invoice.pdf".

removeTooltip.description: A tooltip on the remove button (the real Tooltip around it), e.g. "Remove". None by default.

removeProps.description: Attributes for the remove button (React and Svelte: spread on it; Vue: v-bind), e.g. a data attribute the owner uses to move focus after a removal, or an engine's delete-trigger props.

slots.icon: A glyph before the label (React: icon node; Vue: #icon slot; Svelte: icon snippet). Replaces the dot.

notes: The dot and the icon are aria-hidden; the label carries the meaning. Tone alone never does.
The remove button needs an aria-label that names the tag (removeLabel), and focus must go somewhere sensible after removal (the owner of the list decides).

events.remove: the remove button was clicked (React onRemove, Vue @remove, Svelte onremove)

motion: remove button: the button's press scale; hover and press tint the tag's own colour at duration.fast, ease
